capacity: Use existing approved production capacity; no additional posting or AI schedule
evidenceRules: Compare within platform and vertical at the same observation age
Do not treat platform copies as independent creatives
Do not map revised scripts onto older uploads
Views select reach winners during the approved pre-revenue phase; sales evidence is not required
Reach improvement is not revenue or profit

approval.scope: Prioritized growth plan and pilot within existing production capacity

selectionPolicy.decision: Prefer the arm with higher median D+7 views; report sample count and spread. Ties or inadequate coverage remain inconclusive.
selectionPolicy.unavailableViews: Keep unavailable; do not substitute impressions or zero.
